units.purpose: PGFORCE setup and vertical grand loops: geopotential FIM by upward recursion from FIS, APEL, DFI per level (one thread per column). In: T, Q, CW, PD, PINT, FIS -> fim_3d, apel_3d, dfi_3d.
Pressure-gradient force components behind H points (pcx, pcy, pcne, pcnw) with the nonhydrostatic correction. In: fim_3d, apel_3d, PINT, DWDT -> pgf scratch arrays.
Divergence correction (Janjic 1974/1979) of the PGF with wpdar. In: pgf scratch (PGX/PGY/PGNE/PGNW_3D), wpdar (init-grid-consts), tile limits (drv-loop-limits) -> DIV.

PGF u/v tendency update: TCU, TCV += pressure-gradient terms from PGX/PGY/PGNE/PGNW (or TCU, TCV zeroed on a fresh first step). In: PGX_3D, PGY_3D, PGNE_3D, PGNW_3D, PD, DSG2, PDSG1, RDXV, RDYV -> TCU, TCV. Does not use cfc/bfc; U, V advance in dyn-updateuv.
Horizontal divergence and pressure advection term in the T equation: mass and pressure fluxes on H points, zero divergence on the regional boundary. In: U, V, PD, PINT -> DIV, RTOP, TDIV.
DDAMP setup and external-mode divergence (vertically integrated). In: DIV, PD, DSG2, PDSG1 -> external-mode divergence scratch.
SKIP (ELSE branch of extmod, unreachable: extmod is .true. PARAMETER). Not in the step plan; kernel kept. Divergence damping of U, V is done by dyn-ddamp-extmode.
Surface-pressure tendency PSDT and vertical mass flux PSGDT on interfaces, PD update, regional boundary conditions. In: DIV, PD, DSG2, PDSG1 -> PD, PDO, PSDT, PSGDT.
ADV1 setup and Crank-Nicolson (uncentred w1/w2) vertical advection of T: forward sweep on rcmt/crt, back substitution, one thread per column. In: T, PSGDT, PD -> vertical T tendency.
Temperature fluxes on H points and Adams-Bashforth horizontal advection of T (secadv, 2nd order). In: T, U, V, PD, TP -> T tendency, TP.
Regional branch: upstream advection of T along the southern, northern, western and eastern rows. In: T, U, V -> T tendency on boundary rows.
Crank-Nicolson vertical advection of U and V on V points (cmw), column sweeps. In: U, V, PSGDT -> vertical U/V tendencies.

Grand vertical loop start: Adams-Bashforth extrapolation of U, V to U1D, V1D and UP, VP (Fortran 1829-1833, ported here because no unit did it), Coriolis and curvature tendency (f, curv), diagonally averaged fluxes on V points. In: U, V, UP, VP, PFX..PFNW -> U1D, V1D, UP, VP, TCU, TCV, flux scratch.
Momentum advection (2nd order since secadv=true; 4th-order branch kept) and advection of u1d/v1d with Adams-Bashforth. In: U, V, flux scratch, UP, VP -> U, V, UP, VP.
Regional branch: upstream advection of momentum along the four lateral boundaries, final U, V, T update of ADV1. In: U, V, tendencies -> U, V, T.

Omega-alpha term (vertical advection/conversion) of the thermodynamic equation: OMGALF and TCT (+= toa) and the interface pressure PINT from PSDT, TDIV, DWDT, RTOP, SG2 and EF4T (int_state%EF4T, rescaled only on DFI steps). In: PSDT, TDIV, DWDT, RTOP, SG2, PINT -> OMGALF, TCT, PINT (T tendency applied by dyn-updatet).
Apply the tracer tendency to every tracer in kss..kse (q_tracer and tracers calls). In: TRACERS, TRACERS_TEND -> TRACERS, zeroed TRACERS_TEND.
Apply the T tendency (advection + omega-alpha). In: T, TCT -> T.
Apply the U, V tendencies TCU, TCV. In: U, V, TCU, TCV -> U, V.
HDIFF setup and grand vertical loop: deformation and nonlinear Smagorinsky coefficients (smag2 0.4, 4x for Q and CW), boundary zeroing. In: U, V, T, Q, CW, Q2 -> diffusion coefficients.
Apply second-order horizontal diffusion contributions behind mass points to T, Q, CW, Q2, U, V. In: coefficients, fields -> T, Q, CW, Q2, U, V.
CDZDT setup and nonhydrostatic equation: height Z of interfaces and local dz/dt from the mass field. In: T, Q, PINT, PD, FIS -> Z, W (local part).
Grand horizontal loop: mass fluxes on H points, horizontal advection of height, w=0 on the boundaries. In: Z, U, V, PD -> W.
Take the external (barotropic) mode out of W. In: W, PD, DSG2 -> W.
CDWDT setup; no w diffusion in the backward DFI step; smoothing of w on H points along the boundaries. In: W, DWDT -> W.
Local time derivative of w on H points. In: W, W old -> DWDT.
Lateral diffusion of w. In: W, coefficients -> DWDT.
Vertical advection of w (column). In: W, PSGDT -> DWDT.
Horizontal advection of w. In: W, U, V -> DWDT.
Take the external mode out of dw/dt, cos^2 attenuation in the top 15 hPa. In: DWDT -> DWDT.
Spatial filtering of DWDT, DWDT set to 1 on boundary H points. In: DWDT -> DWDT.
Implicit vertically propagating sound waves: one tridiagonal per column (b1, b2, b3, c0, chi), updates PINT, W, T; DWDT=1 on boundaries. In: PINT, W, DWDT, T, PD -> PINT, W, T.
ADV2 setup for a tracer group, interpolation of Q2 (2*TKE) from interfaces to midlayers, sqrt transform for positive definiteness. In: TRACERS, Q2 -> advected-variable scratch.
Crank-Nicolson vertical advection of the tracer group (column sweeps). In: scratch, PSGDT -> tendencies.
Tracer fluxes on H points and horizontal advection of species. In: scratch, U, V, PD -> tendencies.
Regional branch: upstream advection of species along the four boundaries. In: scratch, U, V -> tendencies.
MONO setup and per-species monotonisation (local min/max limiter, sum of positive and negative changes). In: tracer, tendency -> limited tendency, local sums.
Global mass sums per species and the conservation rescale factor, as a device reduction (replaces MPI_Allreduce). In: local sums -> scale factors (device).
Interpolate Q2 tendencies and Q2 from midlayers back to interfaces. In: scratch -> Q2.
